rationale: Project-specific structural-reduction acceptance limits chosen before Beijing PF results are read. These values are not IEEE, regulatory, or industry-standard limits.
source_reference: PYPSA_FULL_PROJECTION; reuse only when source model, operating-point, and solver-contract digests match.

cutset_p_max_absolute_error_mw.reference_magnitude_definition: maximum absolute S1 reference P over the mapped cluster cutset aggregates for this policy

cutset_q_max_absolute_error_mvar.reference_magnitude_definition: maximum absolute S1 reference Q over the mapped cluster cutset aggregates for this policy

threshold_evaluation.mapping_coverage_definition: Every source Bus is mapped; every source Line or Transformer is either explicitly comparable or explicitly absorbed_internal; no required PF comparison object is missing.
threshold_evaluation.preserved_comparison_coverage_definition: Every preserved singleton Bus is represented in both solved results and in the preserved-Bus voltage metric sample count.
